scripts.build: npm run build -w @educa/shared && npm run build -w @educa/nucleo && npm run build -w @educa/api && npm run build -w @educa/realtime && npm run build -w @educa/despachante && npm run build -w @educa/worker && npm run build -w @educa/web

scripts.ops:uso: npm run -s build -w @educa/shared && npm run -s build -w @educa/nucleo && npm run -s build -w @educa/api && node --env-file=.env.example apps/api/dist/ops/uso.js
scripts.ensaio:alertas: npm run -s build -w @educa/shared && npm run -s build -w @educa/nucleo && npm run -s build -w @educa/api && node --env-file=.env.example --env-file-if-exists=.env infra/scripts/ensaio-alertas.ts
